finding: Heart sounds dual, soft S4. No murmur. No rub.

result: Sinus bradycardia 54/min. ST elevation 2–3 mm in II, III and aVF. Reciprocal ST depression in I and aVL. No LBBB.

utterance: Graham, your ECG is showing some changes that suggest you might be having a heart attack. I'm going to call an ambulance to get you to the hospital as quickly as possible for further assessment and treatment.

utterance: I'm afraid not, Graham. It's not safe for you to drive yourself to the hospital. Your condition requires immediate medical attention, and an ambulance will be equipped to handle any emergencies on the way.
